rules.name: even_ranks_only
rules.description: Cards with even ranks are accepted.

rules.name: red_cards_only
rules.description: Only red cards (hearts and diamonds) are accepted.

rules.name: hearts_and_clubs
rules.description: Only hearts and clubs are accepted.

rules.name: alternating_colors
rules.description: Cards must alternate between red and black colors.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
last_card = mainline[-1]
return card.color != last_card.color

rules.name: rank_higher_than_previous
rules.description: Each card's rank must be higher than the previous one.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
last_card = mainline[-1]
return card.rank > last_card.rank

rules.name: same_suit_as_previous
rules.description: Each card must have the same suit as the previous one.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
last_card = mainline[-1]
return card.suit.suit_name == last_card.suit.suit_name

rules.name: red_to_low_rank_black_to_high_rank
rules.description: Red cards must have a rank ≤ 7, and black cards must have a rank ≥ 7.

rules.name: alternating_ranks_odd_even
rules.description: Cards must alternate between odd and even ranks.
rules.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
last_card = mainline[-1]
if last_card.rank % 2 == 0:  # Last card was even
    return card.rank % 2 != 0  # This card must be odd
else:  # Last card was odd
    return card.rank % 2 == 0  # This card must be even

rules.name: increasing_then_decreasing_ranks
rules.description: Ranks must first increase and then decrease (e.g., 3, 5, 7, 5, 3).
rules.code:
# Simplified logic for demonstration; actual implementation might require tracking state
if not mainline:
    return True
last_card = mainline[-1]
if len(mainline) < 3:  # First two cards must increase
    return card.rank > last_card.rank
else:  # After the third card, ranks must decrease
    return card.rank < last_card.rank

rules.name: specific_suit_sequence
rules.description: Cards must follow a sequence of suits (hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades, repeat).
rules.code:
suit_sequence = ["hearts", "diamonds", "clubs", "spades"]
if not mainline:
    return card.suit.suit_name == suit_sequence[0]
last_card = mainline[-1]
current_index = suit_sequence.index(last_card.suit.suit_name)
next_index = (current_index + 1) % len(suit_sequence)
return card.suit.suit_name == suit_sequence[next_index]
